import gc, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from plan_worst import build
from common import validate
import planning

def timed(label, job, force=None):
    ctx = validate(job)
    active = {r['id']: True for r in job['requests']}
    orig = planning._slack
    if force == 'flow': planning._slack = lambda *a, **k: False
    gc.disable()
    t = time.time()
    try:
        plan = planning.solve(ctx, active)
    finally:
        planning._slack = orig; gc.enable()
    print('%-40s resolved=%-5d cost=%-14d %6.1fs maxrss=%.0fMB' % (
        label, plan['resolved'], plan['cost'], time.time()-t,
        resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024))

for nreq, noff, per, qcap in ((1000,1000,50,400),(2000,4000,50,1000),(4096,8192,32,2000)):
    job = build(nreq, noff, per, quota_cap=qcap)
    timed('networkx nreq=%d noff=%d qcap=%d' % (nreq,noff,qcap), job, force='flow')
PYEOF
